package tzplanner

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const maximumAuthoringResponseBytes int64 = 2 << 20

var digestPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)

type Client struct {
	BaseURL       string
	InternalToken string
	HTTPClient    *http.Client
}

func (client Client) EnsureAuthoringJob(ctx context.Context, idempotencyKey string, request domain.TZAuthoringRequestV2) (domain.TZAuthoringJob, error) {
	if !canonicalUUID(idempotencyKey) || request.Orchestration.CorrelationID != idempotencyKey ||
		domain.ValidateProjectTZAuthoringRequest(request) != nil {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return client.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/internal/v1/authoring-jobs", idempotencyKey, request)
}

func (client Client) GetAuthoringJob(ctx context.Context, jobID string) (domain.TZAuthoringJob, error) {
	if !canonicalUUID(jobID) {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return client.do(ctx, http.MethodGet, "/internal/v1/authoring-jobs/"+url.PathEscape(jobID), "", nil)
}

func (client Client) ResumeAuthoringJob(ctx context.Context, jobID string) (domain.TZAuthoringJob, error) {
	if !canonicalUUID(jobID) {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return client.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/internal/v1/authoring-jobs/"+url.PathEscape(jobID)+"/resume", "", nil)
}

func (client Client) StageAuthoringJob(ctx context.Context, jobID string) (domain.TZAuthoringJob, error) {
	if !canonicalUUID(jobID) {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return client.do(ctx, http.MethodPost, "/internal/v1/authoring-jobs/"+url.PathEscape(jobID)+"/stage", "", nil)
}

func (client Client) do(ctx context.Context, method, path, idempotencyKey string, payload any) (domain.TZAuthoringJob, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(client.InternalToken) == "" || client.HTTPClient == nil {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, errors.New("tz planner client is not configured")
	}
	var body io.Reader
	if payload != nil {
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(payload)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, err
		}
		body = bytes.NewReader(encoded)
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+path, body)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	if payload != nil {
		request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	}
	if idempotencyKey != "" {
		request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", idempotencyKey)
	}
	noRedirect := *client.HTTPClient
	noRedirect.CheckRedirect = func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }
	response, err := noRedirect.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable, err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.ContentLength > maximumAuthoringResponseBytes {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	contents, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, maximumAuthoringResponseBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable, err)
	}
	if int64(len(contents)) > maximumAuthoringResponseBytes {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	if response.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || response.StatusCode >= http.StatusMultipleChoices {
		switch response.StatusCode {
		case http.StatusNotFound:
			return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrNotFound
		case http.StatusConflict:
			return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrConflict
		case http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity:
			return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrValidation
		default:
			return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable
		}
	}
	mediaType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(response.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if err != nil || mediaType != "application/json" {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	var projection jobProjection
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(contents))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&projection); err != nil {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	job, err := projection.normalize()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	return job, nil
}

type jobProjection struct {
	ID                 string                          `json:"id"`
	Status             domain.TZAuthoringJobStatus     `json:"status"`
	Attempts           int                             `json:"attempts"`
	Orchestration      *domain.TZAuthoringIntentV1     `json:"orchestration,omitempty"`
	FailureCode        string                          `json:"failure_code,omitempty"`
	Blueprint          json.RawMessage                 `json:"blueprint,omitempty"`
	CandidateDigest    string                          `json:"candidate_digest,omitempty"`
	ContractDigest     string                          `json:"contract_digest,omitempty"`
	CapabilitiesDigest string                          `json:"capabilities_digest,omitempty"`
	Verification       *verificationReceiptProjection  `json:"verification,omitempty"`
	Staging            *domain.ProjectStagingReceiptV1 `json:"staging,omitempty"`
}

type verificationReceiptProjection struct {
	Schema               string                       `json:"schema"`
	BlueprintDigest      string                       `json:"blueprint_digest"`
	RuntimeProfileDigest string                       `json:"runtime_profile_digest"`
	ContractDigest       string                       `json:"contract_digest"`
	CapabilitiesDigest   string                       `json:"capabilities_digest"`
	Passed               bool                         `json:"passed"`
	Cases                []verificationCaseProjection `json:"cases"`
	VerifiedAt           time.Time                    `json:"verified_at"`
	ReceiptDigest        string                       `json:"receipt_digest"`
}

type verificationCaseProjection struct {
	ID             string `json:"id"`
	Kind           string `json:"kind"`
	ExpectedPassed bool   `json:"expected_passed"`
	ActualPassed   bool   `json:"actual_passed"`
	ResultDigest   string `json:"result_digest"`
}

func (projection jobProjection) normalize() (domain.TZAuthoringJob, error) {
	projection.ID = strings.TrimSpace(projection.ID)
	projection.FailureCode = strings.TrimSpace(projection.FailureCode)
	if !canonicalUUID(projection.ID) || projection.Attempts < 0 || projection.Orchestration == nil ||
		!validIntent(*projection.Orchestration) || !validTZStatus(projection.Status) {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	job := domain.TZAuthoringJob{
		ID: projection.ID, Status: projection.Status, Attempts: projection.Attempts,
		FailureCode: projection.FailureCode, Intent: *projection.Orchestration,
	}
	if projection.Status != domain.TZAuthoringReady && projection.Status != domain.TZAuthoringStaged {
		if len(projection.Blueprint) != 0 || projection.Verification != nil || projection.Staging != nil ||
			projection.CandidateDigest != "" || projection.ContractDigest != "" || projection.CapabilitiesDigest != "" {
			return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if projection.Status == domain.TZAuthoringFailed && projection.FailureCode == "" {
			return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		return job, nil
	}
	if !jsonObject(projection.Blueprint) || projection.Verification == nil ||
		!digestPattern.MatchString(projection.CandidateDigest) || !digestPattern.MatchString(projection.ContractDigest) ||
		!digestPattern.MatchString(projection.CapabilitiesDigest) || !validVerification(*projection.Verification) ||
		projection.Verification.ContractDigest != projection.ContractDigest ||
		projection.Verification.CapabilitiesDigest != projection.CapabilitiesDigest {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	blueprintHash := sha256.Sum256(projection.Blueprint)
	if "sha256:"+hex.EncodeToString(blueprintHash[:]) != projection.Verification.BlueprintDigest {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	job.BlueprintDigest = projection.Verification.BlueprintDigest
	job.CandidateDigest = projection.CandidateDigest
	job.ContractDigest = projection.ContractDigest
	job.CapabilitiesDigest = projection.CapabilitiesDigest
	job.VerificationDigest = projection.Verification.ReceiptDigest
	if projection.Staging != nil {
		receipt := *projection.Staging
		job.Staging = &receipt
	}
	if domain.ValidateTZAuthoringJob(job) != nil {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var identity struct {
		Identity struct {
			FamilyKey  string `json:"family_key"`
			VariantKey string `json:"variant_key"`
		} `json:"identity"`
	}
	if job.Staging != nil && (json.Unmarshal(projection.Blueprint, &identity) != nil || identity.Identity.FamilyKey != job.Staging.FamilyKey || identity.Identity.VariantKey != job.Staging.VariantKey) {
		return domain.TZAuthoringJob{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return job, nil
}

func validIntent(intent domain.TZAuthoringIntentV1) bool {
	return intent.Schema == domain.TZAuthoringIntentSchemaV1 && intent.Trigger == "planner_recommendation" &&
		canonicalUUID(intent.CorrelationID) && intent.SurfaceClassification == "project"
}

func validVerification(receipt verificationReceiptProjection) bool {
	if receipt.Schema != domain.TZVerificationReceiptSchemaV1 || !receipt.Passed || receipt.VerifiedAt.IsZero() ||
		!digestPattern.MatchString(receipt.BlueprintDigest) || !digestPattern.MatchString(receipt.RuntimeProfileDigest) ||
		!digestPattern.MatchString(receipt.ContractDigest) || !digestPattern.MatchString(receipt.CapabilitiesDigest) ||
		!digestPattern.MatchString(receipt.ReceiptDigest) || len(receipt.Cases) < 3 || len(receipt.Cases) > 22 {
		return false
	}
	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
	starter, reference, negatives := 0, 0, 0
	for _, item := range receipt.Cases {
		if strings.TrimSpace(item.ID) == "" || len(item.ID) > 128 || !digestPattern.MatchString(item.ResultDigest) ||
			item.ExpectedPassed != item.ActualPassed {
			return false
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[item.ID]; duplicate {
			return false
		}
		seen[item.ID] = struct{}{}
		switch item.Kind {
		case "starter":
			starter++
			if item.ExpectedPassed {
				return false
			}
		case "reference":
			reference++
			if !item.ExpectedPassed {
				return false
			}
		case "negative":
			negatives++
			if item.ExpectedPassed {
				return false
			}
		default:
			return false
		}
	}
	if starter != 1 || reference != 1 || negatives < 1 {
		return false
	}
	wanted := receipt.ReceiptDigest
	receipt.ReceiptDigest = ""
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(receipt)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	return wanted == "sha256:"+hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
}

func validTZStatus(status domain.TZAuthoringJobStatus) bool {
	return status == domain.TZAuthoringPlanned || status == domain.TZAuthoringGenerating ||
		status == domain.TZAuthoringVerifying || status == domain.TZAuthoringReady || status == domain.TZAuthoringStaged || status == domain.TZAuthoringFailed
}

func jsonObject(raw json.RawMessage) bool {
	var object map[string]json.RawMessage
	return len(raw) > 0 && json.Unmarshal(raw, &object) == nil && object != nil
}

func canonicalUUID(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == value
}

var _ domainservice.ProjectAuthoringTZService = Client{}
